analysis:
At the CII Annual Business Summit on 11 May 2026, Yogi Adityanath said Uttar Pradesh was on track to become a US$1 trillion economy by 2029-30, citing 34 sector-specific policies and growth in mobile and electronic component manufacturing.

A state government briefing reported in December 2025 put UP's GSDP at Rs 29.78 lakh crore and its share of the national economy at 9% in 2024-25, up from 8.6% in 2022-23. At prevailing exchange rates, GSDP of that size is far below US$1 trillion.

The target year is 2029-30 and has not arrived, so the claim is recorded as in progress. Reported timelines for the same goal have varied across statements and years.
notes: Quote is the English wording as published by Fortune India; the speech was likely delivered in Hindi, so quote_original is left blank and quote_is_verbatim=false. Reported timelines for the US$1 trillion goal differ (some outlets reported a 'next three years' framing in 2025, others 2029-30 or 2030); the 2029-30 date is used here. Current US$ conversion assumes roughly Rs 84-88 per dollar and is indicative only.
